content.title: Abstract of Systematic Theology (1887)

content.note: The systematic theology of the founder of the first Southern Baptist seminary. For historic Baptist teaching on God, Scripture, providence, election and salvation, cited by chapter and section. Public domain: may be quoted, with the translator or edition named and an exact locator.
